summary.name: Menew
summary.one_liner: Menew is a free, open source native Swift menu bar app for macOS that combines a command palette, clipboard history, window snapping, screenshots, system monitoring, meeting minutes and on-device AI in one app with no account.
use_cases: Snapping windows to halves, corners and thirds
Monitoring CPU, memory, disk and battery from the menu bar
Transcribing and summarizing meetings on the Mac
Taking screenshots, recordings and scrolling captures
Tracking Claude Code and Codex usage limits
summary.what_it_does: Menew is a menu bar app for macOS that bundles many utilities: a command palette (Ctrl+Opt+Space) for apps, actions, math, conversions, quick links and scripts, and a clipboard history (Cmd+Shift+V) with search, pins, snippets and a paste queue. It includes window snapping with keyboard shortcuts or drag-to-edge, screenshots with annotation and pinning, screen and GIF recording, and a system monitor showing CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery and temperatures. It can record and transcribe meetings into minutes and tasks, and shows usage limits and token costs for AI coding agents. AI features run on Apple's on-device model.
notable: Free and open source under GPL-3.0, no account, no telemetry
Native Swift app with on-device AI via Apple Intelligence
Replaces several paid menu bar utilities such as Raycast, Maccy, Rectangle and iStat Menus in one app
Tracks Claude Code, Codex and other coding agent usage and limits
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; AI features need macOS 26 with Apple Intelligence turned on
Does not sync between Macs or to the cloud and has no extension store
Some features like per-core sensors go less deep than Stats or iStat Menus
